1.title: Beginner Explorer
1.description: Travelers in this category have visited up to 5 cities. They are just starting their journey and usually share first impressions and beginner travel tips.

2.title: Adventurous Wanderer
2.description: These travelers have explored a moderate number of cities, showcasing a growing passion for travel. Their experiences often include varied adventures, detailed itineraries, and travel hacks.

3.title: Seasoned Traveler
3.description: Travelers in this group are experienced with extensive knowledge of diverse destinations. They offer in-depth reviews, cultural insights, and specialized travel advice.

4.title: Globe-Trotter
4.description: Representing a broad range of travel experiences, these travelers have explored many corners of the world. They typically highlight unique and less-traveled destinations, inspiring a wide audience.

5.title: World Explorer
5.description: This elite category includes travelers who have visited an exceptional number of cities. Their experiences often focus on comprehensive global travel, sharing expert-level insights and inspiring stories.
